the quantization of recurrent neural networks.
quantizing recurrent neural networks into binary codes, with the aim of saving memory and improving the inference speed.
quantizing RNNs into multiple binary codes, which can be applied to both language models and image classification.

we propose a novel and effective multi-bit quantization method for RNNs, which is able to achieve the best trade-off among accuracy, memory saving, real inference acceleration and model size.

we can achieve almost zero loss in the accuracy by 3-bit quantizations for both RNNs on language tasks and CNNs on image classification tasks, with significant real inference acceleration and memory saving, and we can even achieve better accuracy with 2-bit quantizations.

we propose an efficient quantization algorithm that can achieve both high accuracy and fast speed.

, we can achieve the state of the art performance on both RNNs (language modeling) and feedforward neural network (image classification), with the best accuracy and the best speed/memory trade-off, compared with the exiting works.

the quantization problem for RNNs is not as difficult as the existing work suggests.
, for recurrent networks, we can achieve a better trade-off between model accuracy and model size than the existing quantization techniques.
